home.categoriesSubtitle: Pick a field to see matching vacancies
home.partnersSubtitle: Companies already hiring through VV Work
home.employerText: List your vacancy on VV Work and reach vetted candidates across Europe — no agency fees, no red tape.
home.aboutText: VV Work is a platform connecting candidates and employers across Europe. We simplify job search and hiring for hundreds of companies.
home.aboutText2: Candidates search for vacancies by job title or category with no sign-up and no hidden fees for applying. Employers post vacancies either through vetted staffing partners or directly — not every company works through an agency, and the platform supports both.
home.aboutText3: We operate in nine cities across Europe — from Warsaw to Prague — and keep expanding our network of partners and direct employers. The goal is simple: make working abroad as easy to arrange as finding an apartment or a flight.
